tasks.final_text: The 1954 Atlantic hurrican season was an above-average Atlantic hurrican seasom in terms of named storms, with 16 forming. Overall, the season resulted in $751.6 million in damage, the most if any season at the time. The season officially beagn on June 15, and nine days later the first named storm developed.
